source: PDE SAP 2025-26 district summary reports, from CSIU Google Drive
schema_notes: Counts are aggregate case counts (no student-level data). referral_source.school_based_team_tiered is the 'Tiered' sub-row under School Based Team(s) (a subset of school_based_team, excluded when summing sources to total_cases). discontinued_reasons keys follow the 13A row order on the report. by_grade K = 'K5 Full Day'; pre-K/K4/K5-half rows are in by_grade_pre_k. sum_checks gives per-block totals for verification against total_cases.
